description: Return the acquisition plan for one credential on a target: the provider URL, the exact non-interactive command when one exists (e.g. `opencode auth login`, `opencode mcp auth vercel`, `gh auth login`), and whether it is already present. Read-only and value-blind: it emits guidance and re-checks presence with one read-only probe; it does not run the commands or handle secret values. Parameter semantics: `var` must be an env var name returned by list_required_credentials (unknown names error); `target` selects the machine and its `home` is where the value should be written. Use it for a single credential; it does not replace that listing.

target.description: The machine to operate on: this host (local) or a remote host over SSH (ssh).

mode.description: Run on this machine (local) or a remote host (ssh).

user.description: SSH user (defaults to ssh config / current user).

var.description: Credential env var name from list_required_credentials (e.g. OPENCODE_API_KEY).

name: run_auth_flow

command.description: Command for the agent/user to run.

present.description: Whether the credential is present now.

verified.description: True when the credential is present and ready.

title: Acquire one credential (best-effort)
